title: PRE/POST reads and two-read checks for the universal evaluator
body:
- JobSpec: `nodes` → `logic`; an unset mutability flag now means BOTH.
- `Read.at` (PRE / POST execution). `Check.left` / `right` are lists of reads, each side summed: CMP `Σleft op target`, NUM / PCT `Σleft` against `Σright`, across chains and moments. Up to 32 reads and 64 terms.
- Evaluator: PRE reads go out at `fund`, POST at `submit`. `snapshotOf` / `snapshotRequestOf` removed; `evidenceOf` returns one hash. `JobSpecLib.validate` is now a linked library (evaluator 23.5 KB).
- Hook: deployed fresh with the evaluator (`scripts/agentic-commerce-8183`). `initializeV2` and RulesBindingHook removed; UniversalHook does the rules binding, and its errors are all in `UniversalHookErrors` (same selectors).
- Tests: 27 end-to-end criteria cases, judge truth tables, a max-terms gas case, deploy tests; marketplace gas ceilings re-measured.
